newsitem.title: SPAIN: Europe must press ahead with euro work - Schieber.
newsitem.headline: Europe must press ahead with euro work - Schieber.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Helmut Schieber said on Monday that Europe must press ahead with legal preparations for the introduction of the euro.

"Great attention should be devoted to the preparatory work...This applies not least to the legal preconditions for introducing the euro and includes not only comprehensive legal adjustments at a national level...as well as considerable changes in intra-European regulations but also the legal implementation of the euro worldwide," Schieber told a seminar in Madrid.

Schieber noted that the time that remains in 1998 to adapt financial systems, legal norms and technical aspects following the selection of the countries that will launch the euro "will be extremely scarce."
He added that these changes may reveal new problems and conflicts.

"...We cannot afford any mistakes or even failure in the preparatory work; we have only one shot, so to speak. One relevant factor here is that we cannot rule out a certain volatility in foreign exchange markets or considerable changeover problems in the financial sector, the enterprise sector and the numerous public bodies at the start of monetary union," he said.
